craft_notes: Sthāyin: fattening and melting. Rows: fill then melt. Read aloud: wax then wane.

lines: In dark half the in-breath moon fattens digit by digit
till on the fifteenth, by the twelve-end, the thinned moon
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra kṛṣṇapakṣe prāṇārke apānacandra āpyāyikām ekām ekāṃ kalām arpayati yāvat pañcadaśyāṃ tuṭau dvādaśāntasamīpe kṣīṇapṛthagbhūtakalāprasaraḥ candramāḥ prāṇārka eva līyate
